name: Matsuzaka Chinami
source:
A middle-aged woman working as a cook in the school cafeteria. Her kind personality makes her beloved by the students. Her figure shows slight signs of age-related sagging.

Having gone without sex with her husband for a long time, she is extremely starved for sexual activity.

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/puzzlebox/yuuwakuonnakyoushi/character.htmll]official site[/url]]
